item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 23/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the coast of southern China at night on the second day of the Lunar New Year. Under the influence of the associated intense northeast monsoon, it will become cold appreciably and windy over the region on the third and fourth days of the Lunar New Year. A dry replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the latter part of this week. Under the influence of the dry monsoon, the weather will improve with cold mornings over the region during the weekend. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.

Weather: Sunny periods. Visibility relatively low in some areas. One or two light rain patches at night.
